answers.risk_controls_on_a_-1.8%_day: No swing positions here, so nothing like your stop tightening or market circuit breaker exists or fired. Everything is same-day or nearest-expiry long options sized at 20% of the ledger per trade, so the premium is the stop. The controls that act on days like this: (1) no new entry on a name that reports today or the next trading day (did not block anything today: INTC/AMZN/COIN reported last night); (2) a per-variant ledger pauses to shadow-only after a losing streak (none paused today); (3) carries only for news picks, closed at 15:45 if the name reports the next day. One gap we found today is execution, not risk: the 09:39 trail exit on the ORCL put was a market sell and filled 1.82 against a 2.635 mark (-31%)
